<subject>Regarding Our Recent Discussion</subject>
<body>
Hello,

Apologies for the delay in getting back to you. The more I reflect on it, the more I feel this isn’t a beneficial direction for either of us, both professionally and personally. I continue to consider you a valued friend. Nothing has altered that, and I believe we can continue to interact naturally moving forward. What we tried was something we both wanted to explore, but perhaps it’s best to leave it at that.

Best regards,  
Marc  
Lumière Santé SAS  
</body>
